description: One-call stock research brief for any ticker or company: the quote plus one-year performance (1w, 1m, 3m, 6m, 1y), annualized volatility, maximum drawdown, 20/50/200-day moving averages, RSI(14), volume trend, 52-week range position and a rules-based bullish/neutral/bearish signal with the reasons and risk flags behind it. Deterministic, from one year of daily closes; no model call. Use to brief an agent or user on a stock before a decision. Example: symbol=AAPL. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

symbol.description: Ticker (AAPL, ^GSPC, BTC-USD) or a company name
